content:
Japan is not a market that can be entered successfully through translation alone. Sports, wellness and performance products must fit the way Japanese coaches, facilities, parents and organizations actually make decisions.
The problem with launching too earlyMany international companies begin with a translated website, a distributor list or a large launch plan. The missing step is field validation: learning how the product is understood, used and evaluated by the people who would actually introduce it.
What a pilot should answerA useful Japan pilot identifies the right customer, the decision-maker, the acceptable price, the operational barriers and the evidence required before a partnership can move forward.
JPNentry helps international sports and performance companies validate these questions through local research, partner conversations and carefully scoped pilot opportunities.
From evidence to partnershipThe goal is not to produce a long report. The goal is to decide whether Japan is a fit, what must change, and which Japanese partners should be contacted next.
Start with a Japan Market Validation through JPNentry: https://www.jpnentry.com/

content:
JPNentry is building a field-based Japan Pilot Lab for international sports, wellness, education and performance companies.
What the Japan Pilot Lab doesThe Pilot Lab connects a carefully selected overseas product or service with relevant Japanese organizations, coaches, trainers, facilities and business partners. The process is designed to create usable evidence before a company commits to a large distribution or marketing budget.
The 30-day processFirst, we clarify the product, target customer and intended outcome. Next, we map the Japanese market and identify relevant partners. We then gather structured feedback, refine the positioning and prepare the next commercial conversations.
What makes it differentJPNentry combines market-entry research with real sports and performance networks. The result is not a generic list of companies. It is a practical view of where the product can fit, what needs to change and who should be approached.
Suitable categoriesThe model is suitable for sports technology, recovery and performance products, coaching education, youth sports services, wellness solutions and selected facility technologies.
Request a Japan Pilot conversation: https://www.jpnentry.com/

title: Night Japan Beta｜抵达游客难以独自找到的日本
description: 以安全为前提，连接地方夜间文化、当地向导与安全返程信息的Night Japan Beta。
content:
ACCESS THE JAPAN TOURISTS CAN’T REACH ON THEIR OWN.
Night Japan Beta不是又一份酒吧排行榜。相比东京、大阪和京都的热门夜生活，我们更关注地方城市的小酒馆街、横丁、温泉街、港口小镇、旧花街、深夜食堂、本地酒吧、夜祭，以及正在消失的夜间文化。
每个地区和地点将尽可能提供隐秘度、当地独特性、消失风险、语言门槛、交通便利度、价格透明度、安全提示、最后核实日期、最佳到访时间、安全返程方式、当地礼仪与紧急信息。
Safety Guide不会用犯罪话题制造恐慌，而是准确说明出发前应了解的事项，包括拉客、价格不透明、座位费或计时收费、末班车、深夜交通、自然灾害、禁入区域、拍摄礼仪和酒后驾驶。
Local Host仅限文化介绍、语言协助和连接当地社区，不是约会或性服务。身份与年龄核验、评价、紧急联系、举报机制和安全规则完善前，仅开放Waitlist。
18+ Culture Guide仅提供术语、价格结构、法律注意、同意原则、常见误解和纠纷预防等信息与安全教育。JPNentry不会为性服务进行撮合、预约、收款或收取介绍费。
Night Japan Passport计划提供免费的基础信息，以及付费的Deep Guide、收藏地图和会员限定体验。月度会员与30天通行证将在服务范围、履约方式和法律审查完成后再开放。
涉及饮酒的Night Japan与Drive Japan完全分开。饮酒后只会建议出租车、公共交通、步行或住宿等安全返程方式，绝不建议驾车。
首批研究方向包括仙台夜间文化、东北地区正在消失的夜街和石垣岛。尚未核实的地点或供应未确定的体验不会显示Book Now，只会显示Join the Waitlist。
如果你不满足于打卡热门景点，而想真正理解一座城市的夜，请填写城市、旅行日期、使用语言和感兴趣的夜间文化，加入Night Japan Beta Waitlist。

title: Night Japan Beta｜観光客だけでは辿り着けない日本へ
description: 地方の夜文化を、安全情報・地域とのつながり・安全な帰宅手段まで含めて案内するNight Japan Beta。
content:
ACCESS THE JAPAN TOURISTS CAN’T REACH ON THEIR OWN.
Night Japan Betaは、よくあるバーランキングではありません。東京・大阪・京都の有名な夜ではなく、地方のスナック街、横丁、温泉街、港町、元花街、深夜飯、ローカルバー、夜祭り、そして消えかけている夜文化を優先して掘り下げます。
各地域・スポットには、可能な限りObscurity Score、Local Uniqueness、Vanishing Risk、Language Barrier、Accessibility、Price Transparency、Safety Notes、Last Verified Date、Best Time to Visit、安全な帰宅方法、Local Etiquette、Emergency Informationを掲載します。
Safety Guideは地域を危険に見せるためのものではありません。客引き、料金の不透明さ、席料や時間制料金、終電、深夜交通、災害、立入禁止、撮影マナー、飲酒運転など、行く前に知るべきことを正確に伝えます。
Local Hostは文化案内・通訳補助・地域との橋渡しに限定します。デートや性的サービスではありません。本人確認、年齢確認、レビュー、緊急連絡、通報機能、安全ルールの準備が整うまではWaitlistのみ受け付けます。
18+ Culture Guideは、用語、料金体系、法律上の注意、同意、誤解しやすい点、トラブル回避に関する情報提供と安全教育に限定します。JPNentryが性的サービスを仲介、予約、決済したり、紹介料を受け取ったりすることはありません。
Night Japan Passportは、無料の基本情報と有料のDeep Guide・保存マップ・限定体験を想定しています。月額プランと30日パスは、提供範囲・履行方法・法務確認が完了してから公開します。
飲酒を含むNight JapanとDrive Japanは完全に分離します。飲酒後はタクシー、公共交通、徒歩、宿泊など安全な帰宅方法だけを案内し、運転は一切推奨しません。
最初の調査地域は、仙台の夜文化、東北の消えかけた夜の街、石垣島などです。未確認のスポットや供給未確定の体験はBook Nowにせず、Join the Waitlistとして公開します。
観光地を消費するだけではなく、その土地の夜を理解したい方へ。都市、旅行日、使用言語、興味のある夜文化を添えて、Night Japan BetaのWaitlistにご登録ください。

title: Night Japan Beta｜여행자가 혼자서는 닿기 어려운 일본으로
description: 지역의 밤문화와 안전 정보, 로컬 연결, 대기 등록형 체험을 잇는 JPNentry의 Beta 플랫폼입니다.
content:
ACCESS THE JAPAN TOURISTS CAN’T REACH ON THEIR OWN.
Night Japan Beta는 평범한 바 추천 목록이 아닙니다. 도쿄·오사카·교토의 유명한 밤거리보다 지방의 스낵바 골목, 요코초, 온천마을, 항구도시, 옛 유흥가, 심야 음식, 로컬 바, 밤축제, 사라져 가는 밤문화를 우선적으로 조사합니다.
각 지역과 장소에는 가능하면 희소성, 지역 고유성, 소멸 위험, 언어 장벽, 접근성, 가격 투명성, 안전 메모, 마지막 확인일, 방문하기 좋은 시간, 안전한 귀가 방법, 지역 예절, 긴급 정보를 제공합니다.
Safety Guide는 특정 지역을 위험하다고 자극적으로 묘사하지 않습니다. 호객, 불명확한 요금, 자리세와 시간제 요금, 막차, 심야 교통, 재난, 출입 금지 구역, 촬영 예절, 음주운전 등 방문 전에 알아야 할 내용을 정확히 설명합니다.
Local Host는 문화 안내, 언어 지원, 지역과의 연결 역할만 담당합니다. 데이트나 성적 서비스, 유흥업소 알선이 아닙니다. 신원·연령 확인, 리뷰, 긴급 연락, 신고 기능, 안전 규칙을 전제로 하며 운영 및 법률 검토가 끝날 때까지 대기 등록만 받습니다.
18+ Culture Guide는 용어, 요금 구조, 법적 주의, 동의, 오해하기 쉬운 부분과 분쟁 예방을 설명하는 정보 레이어입니다. JPNentry는 성적 서비스를 중개·예약·결제하거나 소개 수수료를 받지 않습니다.
Night Japan Passport는 무료 기본 콘텐츠와 유료 심층 콘텐츠로 구분할 예정입니다. 월 정액과 30일 패스는 서비스 범위와 이행 조건, 법률 검토가 완료된 뒤에만 판매합니다.
술이 포함된 Night Japan과 Drive Japan은 완전히 분리됩니다. 음주 후에는 택시, 대중교통, 도보 또는 숙박을 안내하며 운전을 권하지 않습니다.
초기 조사 지역은 센다이, 도호쿠의 사라져 가는 밤거리, 이시가키섬입니다. 현장 확인이 끝나지 않은 장소와 공급이 확정되지 않은 체험에는 Book Now가 아니라 Join the Waitlist만 표시합니다.
대기 등록을 원하면 JPNentry 문의 페이지에서 ‘NIGHT JAPAN’과 함께 도시, 여행 날짜, 사용 언어, 관심 있는 밤문화를 보내 주세요.

title: Drive Japan Beta: The Japan You Can’t Reach by Train
description: A sober-travel guide to driving eligibility, ETC, fuel, EV charging, parking, insurance, accidents, snow roads and car-only Deep Japan.
content:
THE JAPAN YOU CAN’T REACH BY TRAIN.
Drive Japan Beta is the sober-travel entry point for rural coastlines, mountain towns, small museums, workshops, remote food culture and landscapes that are difficult to reach by rail.
CAN I DRIVE IN JAPAN?
Your eligibility depends on the licence you hold, the issuing country or region, the correct international permit or official translation where applicable, and the period and conditions of use. Do not rely on a generic online answer for a booking. Confirm the latest requirements with the relevant Japanese authorities and rental operator before travel.
THE DRIVE JAPAN CHECKLIST
International driving eligibility; vehicle class; insurance and excess; ETC and toll roads; fuel type; EV charging; parking; accident procedure; emergency contacts; winter equipment; snow and ice; mountain roads; tunnels; narrow local streets; road signs; speed limits; seat belts; child restraints; railway crossings and local restrictions.
ETC AND TOLLS
Ask whether the rental includes an ETC card, how tolls are settled and whether any regional pass applies to the actual route. Do not assume every rental plan or lane accepts the same payment method.
FUEL AND EV CHARGING
Confirm the correct fuel before leaving the counter. Rural stations may close early. For EV travel, check connector compatibility, charging access, operating hours and a backup charger; map coverage alone is not a guarantee that a charger is available.
PARKING
Use marked legal parking. Do not block narrow streets, private homes, working ports, farm access, emergency routes or snow-clearing areas. Hotel or attraction parking does not automatically allow overnight vehicle stays.
INSURANCE AND ACCIDENTS
Understand what is covered, the deductible, non-operation charges, roadside assistance and who must be contacted after any incident. Stop safely, assist anyone injured, call police and the rental company, and follow the insurer’s procedure. Do not privately settle and leave without required reporting.
SNOW AND MOUNTAIN ROADS
Winter tires do not remove winter risk. Weather, closures, black ice, visibility, avalanche or landslide risk and daylight hours can change quickly. Choose a safer route or cancel when conditions exceed your experience.
CAR-ONLY JAPAN
Future routes will prioritize destinations where a car creates genuine access: rural craft regions, disappearing townscapes, coastal food routes, remote hot springs, mountain settlements and small local operators. Each route should include distance, realistic drive time, rest stops, fuel or charging, parking, signal gaps, weather risk and a sober return plan.
ZERO MIXING WITH NIGHT DRINKING
Drive Japan never recommends driving for an alcohol-centered Night Japan experience. Park before drinking, use a taxi or public transport, designate a sober driver or stay overnight. The next drive begins only when the driver is sober and legally fit.
LOCAL RENTAL PARTNERS
JPNentry plans to work with regional rental operators that can explain vehicle condition, insurance, winter equipment, pickup rules and local route constraints clearly to international visitors. Partner onboarding remains Waitlist-only until responsibilities and terms are reviewed.
BETA AND LEGAL NOTICE
This is general educational information, not an eligibility determination, insurance advice or legal advice. Licence rules, road restrictions and rental conditions can change. High-risk or transaction features are marked 要法務確認 / legal review required and remain draft or Waitlist until cleared.
To join Drive Japan Beta, visit the JPNentry home page and send “DRIVE JAPAN” with your licence country, intended region, travel dates and preferred vehicle type.
